Great place to see the local seafood, I’ve never seen a white tip reef shark in an aquarium before. Lots of lobsters, shrimp, oysters, mussels. You can pick what you want to eat, it is very fresh seafood! I had the mantis shrimp, great flavour. If nothing else, just wander through and see the critters!
